Date: 2023-06-26
Abstract
The invention relates to a method for determining a torque for
an operation of a robot that includes multiple components, using
a model (200) of the robot, two components each of the robot
being movable with the aid of an actuator relative to one another at a connection point, and the model (200) mapping parameters for the connection points onto a torque for the
respective actuator, including: providing values for the
parameters, the parameters including: a position or an angle (q), a velocity (q), and an acceleration (4) of the respective
actuator, the model (200) including a rigid body model (210), a
friction model (220), and a machine learning model (230);
determining one value each of the rigid body partial torque, of the friction partial torque and of the machine learning partial torque based on the values of the parameters and the model
(200); determining a value of the torque (TH) of the respective
actuator based on the values of the rigid body partial torque,
of the friction partial torque and of the machine learning
partial torque; and providing the value of the torque (TH) for the respective actuator for use during the operation, in
particular, of a control or regulating of the robot. The
invention also relates to a method for teaching such a model
(200).
